          0,1,0,
          0,0,1,
          -6,3,0>

  location < 20, 15, -15 >
  right image_width/image_height*x
  look_at <-732232, -402724, 549174>   angle degrees(2*atan(tan(radians(45)/2)*image_width/image_height))
